instruction:
look at `/home/user/Desktop/board.brd`, use the bundled `/home/user/Desktop/testpad.lbr` to add test-point elements, save the updated board as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd`, and write the added-test-point summary to `/home/user/Desktop/testpoint_list.txt`.

Requirements:
1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd` must parse as well-formed XML.
2. Add at least 2 new elements whose refdes starts with `TP_`.
3. At least one `TP_` element must be connected to the `VCC` signal.
4. At least one `TP_` element must be connected to the `GND` signal.
5. Every starter-board element must remain present.
6. The element-count increase must equal the number of added `TP_` elements.
